evals.prompt: Generate a 1024x1024 PNG image of a matte black ceramic mug on a walnut desk with soft window light. Save it to outputs/mug.png and use the current Codex API configuration without asking me for a key.
evals.expected_output: The agent uses the bundled script, reuses Codex config/auth for base URL, model, and API key, calls the Responses API image_generation tool once, and saves outputs/mug.png.

evals.prompt: Create a transparent-background app icon of a folded paper crane, no text, centered with enough padding. Save it as outputs/crane-icon.png.
evals.expected_output: The agent sets background transparent and png output format, runs the bundled script once, and reports the saved file path.

evals.prompt: Restyle reference.png as a polished editorial illustration while preserving composition. Use high input fidelity and save the result to outputs/reference-restyled.png.
evals.expected_output: The agent uses --image reference.png, --action edit, --input-fidelity high, and reports a clear blocker if reference.png is missing.

evals.prompt: Use my custom provider at https://example.com/v1 with the API key in MY_OPENAI_API_KEY. Generate a square watercolor mountain scene and save it to outputs/custom-provider.png.
evals.expected_output: The agent passes --base-url https://example.com/v1 and --api-key-env MY_OPENAI_API_KEY without asking for or printing the secret value.
